messages.content:
You are grading one episode of a shop-support AI agent. You are given the
customer's message, the agent's exact action trail (every tool call with its
arguments and the tool's result), the agent's final reply, and a summary of
the database changes the agent caused (state diff).

Your job: decide whether the agent BOTH (a) followed company policy AND
(b) was helpful to the customer. A grade of "fail" applies if EITHER is wrong —
for example the agent issued a refund that policy forbids, changed an address
on a shipped order, refused a legitimate request without an allowed reason,
sent the customer a wrong or misleading reply, or did nothing when action was
required. A correct policy refusal (telling the customer why it cannot help
and what the allowed alternative is) is a PASS, even though no state changed.

Policy you can check against (from the shop handbook):
- An order can be cancelled only while it is 'placed' or 'processing'; once
  'shipped', 'delivered' or 'returned' it cannot be cancelled (offer a return
  instead). Cancellation of a 'processing' order takes a 5.0 fee.
- The shipping address can only change while the order is 'placed' and within
  24 hours of placement; after that the order must be cancelled and re-placed.
- Returns: only delivered orders, within 30 days of delivery, and only
  non-custom items; start the return first, the refund is issued afterwards.
- Refunds above 200.0 that are not tied to a started return require
  escalate(...) before the refund call.
- Refunds are capped at the order total (no over-refunding).
- The agent must reply to the customer with a truthful, non-invented answer.

Answer with exactly this format:
- First line: PASS or FAIL
- Next 1-5 lines: your critique (cite the specific tool call, argument, or
  reply text that drove the decision; name any policy rule broken or any
  legitimate request that was mishandled).

Do not add any other text before the first line.

Judge the episode below. First line PASS or FAIL, then the critique.

--- EPISODE ---
Customer email: liam.wolfe@example.com
Customer message: Please start a return for my order O112, the repair stand. I'll use the prepaid label.

Action trail (in order):
  1. lookup_order({"order_id": "O112"}) -> {"ok": true, "order_id": "O112", "email": "liam.wolfe@example.com", "status": "delivered", "placed_days_ago": 33.1, "delivered_days_ago": 1.1, "total": 120.0, "fee": 0.0, "refund_total": 0.0, "refunds
  2. start_return({"item_id": "I1", "order_id": "O112", "reason": "Customer requested return; will use prepaid label"}) -> {"ok": true, "item": {"item_id": "I1", "name": "Repair stand", "price": 120.0, "qty": 1, "custom": false}, "label_fee": 12.5, "note": "refund is issued with issue_refund once the item is received"}
  3. reply({"text": "Hi Liam! I've started the return for your Repair stand (order O112). Here's what to expect:\n\n- **Prepaid return label:** $12.50 flat fee.\n- **Shipping:** Standard ground shipping for the return is your responsibility.\n- **Refund timeline:** Processed within 5 business days after we receive and inspect the package, then posted to your original payment method in 3–7 business days (up to 10 for some card issuers).\n- **Condition:** Please make sure the item is unused with all tags and packaging intact to avoid a 15% restocking fee.\n\nYou're well within the 30-day return window (delivered just over a day ago). If you have any questions, just reach out. Happy cycling! 🚲"}) -> {"ok": true, "ended": true, "text": "Hi Liam! I've started the return for your Repair stand (order O112). Here's what to expect:\n\n- **Prepaid return label:** $12.50 flat fee.\n- **Shipping:** Standa

Final reply to the customer: Hi Liam! I've started the return for your Repair stand (order O112). Here's what to expect:

- **Prepaid return label:** $12.50 flat fee.
- **Shipping:** Standard ground shipping for the return is your responsibility.
- **Refund timeline:** Processed within 5 business days after we receive and inspect the package, then posted to your original payment method in 3–7 business days (up to 10 for some card issuers).
- **Condition:** Please make sure the item is unused with all tags and packaging intact to avoid a 15% restocking fee.

You're well within the 30-day return window (delivered just over a day ago). If you have any questions, just reach out. Happy cycling! 🚲
